qa_pair.question: How many tools does the deckproof-mcp server expose?
How many layout archetypes does pptx_list_layouts return (with no template supplied)?
How many structural validation rules does deckproof-mcp check a .pptx against?
Which validation rule catches a slide relationship that exists but is not registered in the presentation's sldIdLst / notesMasterIdLst (the bug that makes files fail to open in Apple Keynote)?
Which underlying library does deckproof-mcp use to clone a template's existing slide as a stencil and refill it?
In deckproof-mcp, is the `path` file input (reading a .pptx from a local disk path) allowed over the remote HTTP transport?
When you call pptx_create_deck with a `template`, are the new slides inserted before or appended after the template's existing slides?
If you build a deck with pptx_create_deck that contains no pictures, what alt-text coverage percentage does pptx_audit report for it?
What HTTP status code does the deckproof-mcp Streamable HTTP server return for a GET request to /mcp?
What severity does the orphanedMedia validation rule report - error or warning?
